# Conventions audit and retirement ledger

Audit base: `d9824dfd3d7df3006a810e7368795fda08f9bd7f` (0.60.1-alpha.1), 7 September 2026. Issue #638; retirement #639.

All 602 non-test typed source files were read against `docs-src/reference/conventions.md`, with four JavaScript operator scripts recorded separately as context. Tests enter this ledger only as consumers or as declarations represented in the existing lint baseline. Source locations below are pinned to the audit base; later renames do not rewrite historical citations.

The original baseline contains 267 declarations: 252 `max-params` and 15 `@typescript-eslint/naming-convention`, across 131 files and 132 file/rule entries. The declaration ledger below reconciles every entry.

R means a local rename; E an exported rename with internal consumers; P parameter shape; S result shape; X a named protected contract; D accepted debt with a reason. X and D proposals describe the convention alternative without authorising it. They are excluded from implementation. All other rows require their reviewed batch footprint and preserved guarantees.

| Class | Rows |
| ----- | ---- |
| R     | 1102 |
| E     | 361  |
| P     | 276  |
| S     | 34   |
| X     | 101  |
| D     | 142  |

## Findings by directory

Each proposal includes its reason and any required compatibility adapter. Consumers list declaration owners, resolved references, returned-property consumers, and relevant tests or path pins. Historical prose references remain historical; no ordinary-word match authorises an unrelated edit.

## Observation and disposition ledger

These entries retain development-guide deviations, boundary/error investigations and nonviolating observations. An investigation is not a confirmed defect. Actionable structural observations feed #647; lint candidates feed #645; boundary/error investigations feed #646. Rule ambiguities feed #643. They are not silently converted into accepted debt.

## Triaged retirement batch list

Package renames precede directory parameter batches, then one result-owning module per batch. Connected authorizer and session-revocation signatures are grouped under their common server source directory so interface and implementation changes land together. The four E+P groups retire every old-file suppression before required file moves. Independent footprints may share one integrated validation run; shared files determine serial dependencies. These are triaged groups, not already-approved implementation briefs. Each independently reviewed implementation brief fixes exact destination names, adapters, focused tests and assertions before editing. A name change coupled to a result representation stays in that result module batch.

The per-batch test lists below are candidate coverage, including broad inherited suites; each reviewed implementation brief narrows them to the relevant named focused tests. For every code batch: run its applicable existing focused tests, typecheck, touched-directory lint and formatter checks; the coordinator owns full `gate`, `gate:server` and `e2e` evidence. Existing assertions retain their guarantees. No mutation tests or Docker-specific work are included.
